text_blocks.snippet: Losartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB) used to treat high blood pressure, protect kidneys in people with type 2 diabetes, and lower the risk of stroke.

list.snippet: Dizziness or lightheadedness (especially when standing up too quickly from a sitting or lying position)
Upper respiratory tract infections or a stuffy/runny nose
Mild gastrointestinal upset (nausea, diarrhea, or vomiting)

text_blocks.snippet: Serious Side Effects (Seek Immediate Medical Care)

list.snippet: Severe allergic reactions (angioedema): Swelling of the face, lips, tongue, throat, or eyes, which can cause trouble breathing or swallowing.
Very low blood pressure (hypotension): Feeling faint, dizzy, or passing out.
High potassium levels: Muscle weakness, slow or irregular heartbeat, or numbness and tingling.
Kidney problems: Decreased amount of urine, blood in the urine, or swelling in the hands, feet, or ankles.
